facts.text: The hotel is in Xi'an's CBD, in the Xi'an Economic and Technological Development Zone, next to the city's administrative center.
facts.excerpt: This Xi’an CBD hotel is located in the Xi’an Economic and Technological Development Zone, adjacent to the administrative center of the city

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to the Wenjing Road subway station.
facts.excerpt: with direct access to the Wenjing Road Subway

facts.text: The hotel's lobby is on the 38th floor.
facts.excerpt: Standing in the lobby of our Xi'an CBD hotel on the 38th floor

facts.text: The lobby and the guest rooms look out over panoramic views of the city.
facts.excerpt: Standing in the lobby of our Xi'an CBD hotel on the 38th floor or in any of the 5-star guestrooms, you will be presented with a large panoramic mesmerizing portrait of the city view

facts.text: The hotel's modern design reflects Xi'an's contemporary character and the refinement of the local culture.
facts.excerpt: The modernistic design of the luxury hotel in Xi'an reflects the contemporary character of this world-famous city and the refinement of the local culture.

facts.text: The hotel blends the ancient heritage of Chang'an with the style of the JW Marriott brand.
facts.excerpt: Blending the ancient beauty of Chang’an with the sophistication of the JW Marriott brand

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor heated pool, a sauna and a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: indoor heated pool, sauna & whirlpool

facts.text: The pool is an infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Infinity Pool

facts.text: Spa by JW is on the hotel's 24th level.
facts.excerpt: Rejuvenate body and mind in Xi'an CBD at our hotel with a spa, located on the 24th level.

facts.text: Spa treatments include Ayurvedic treatments, couples massages and facials.
facts.excerpt:
Ayurvedic Treatment

Couples Massages

Facials

facts.text: The fitness center is on Level 24.
facts.excerpt: fitness center located on Level 24

facts.text: Rooms are elegantly styled with the residential comforts of home.
facts.excerpt: Our Xi'an family hotel is elegantly styled and enhanced with the residential comforts of home.

facts.text: Room types include city-view rooms and suites, up to the Presidential Suite and Ambassador Suite.
facts.excerpt:
Presidential Suite

Executive lounge access, Suite, 1 King, Alternate: sofa bed, City view

facts.text: The JW Executive Lounge is on the 36th floor, a private space for guests to relax or work.
facts.excerpt: Located on 36F. It is an exclusive private space for leisure and business guests to relax or get some work done.

facts.text: JW Kitchen is an all-day restaurant blending local favorites with international cuisine, with à la carte dishes and an international buffet.
facts.excerpt: JW Kitchen is an all-day dining restaurant in Xi'an CBD, blending local favorites with international cuisine and offering à la carte dishes and an international buffet.

facts.text: Jin Wei Court is a Cantonese restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Savor tantalizing Cantonese cuisine in Xi'an CBD ​with an eclectic selection of local favorites in this Cantonese restaurant.

facts.text: The Lounge is a sky-view lounge with a panoramic view, serving selected coffee, tea, wines and dessert.
facts.excerpt: This Xi'an sky view lounge will surprise you not only by the large panoramic view, but also through the delicate tasting of selected coffee, tea, wines and dessert.

facts.text: Parking on site is complimentary for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary parking for in-house guests

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Hotel Xi'an.

facts.text: Xianyang Airport is about 27 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: XIY is located approximately 27.0 KM from the hotel.
